scope: Step B: engine tests and the VM record; the queue leaves are added by its packaging

leaves.name: step-b-connected-network
leaves.replaces: CUDA devices, streams, event buses, the model forward and the MQ transport around NativeSegmentDriver, NativeWorkerBridge, LaneDispatcher, LaneForward, QsaLayerDriver and QsaPrefillOperation
leaves.equivalence: Step A's FusedNetwork leaves, with real stacks on all four ranks and several QSA layers per stage. Events resolve only when the test completes them, so a host wait or a wrong order inside a group shows as a stuck or refused command
leaves.cannot_prove: device order, bytes, NCCL behaviour, real timing

leaves.name: step-b-fake-layers
leaves.replaces: The generated Qwen GDN and QSA decoder layers
leaves.equivalence: c.FakeGdnLayer and c.FakeQsaLayer with c.FakeAttention, the connected suite's declared layers: they enter the real private scope, real driver and real attention seams, at the positions PREPARE names
leaves.cannot_prove: that the real generated layers' kernels are bytewise unchanged by a group: tools/step_b_vm_input.py compares hidden-state hashes on a real 3090

leaves.name: step-b-tp-communicators
leaves.replaces: PyNcclCommunicator, the TP torch module, the TP group and the top-k selection entering the collective
leaves.equivalence: Step A's LeafPynccl and TP_TORCH under the real PrefillTpCommunicator and CollectiveLedger, entered at the seam the generated attention enters them
leaves.cannot_prove: NCCL behaviour or real collective ordering: the box's TP arms

leaves.name: step-b-pending-peer
leaves.replaces: A real worker that returned one typed pending acceptance for a chosen command
leaves.equivalence: A real SegmentAcceptance(pending=True) in front of the real peer bridge. A real group never returns pending: this forces the cancel-between-acceptances order so the driver's retained TP obligation is proved, as in Step A's pending peer
leaves.cannot_prove: that a real worker can reach this state; the test proves what happens if it does

leaves.name: step-b-injected-failures
leaves.replaces: A layer that raises inside a group, a device copy that fails in a later bucket, a peer that refuses before enqueue, a LaneForward.layer that reports a paused record
leaves.equivalence: Each raises from the seam the real failure raises from, so the real quarantine, retained ownership and bounded stop paths run

leaves.name: step-b-reports
leaves.replaces: Worker poll reports' pending_op_seqs in the direct bound checks
leaves.equivalence: The one field the real _fused_hold reads; the connected run-ahead tests drive the same rule through real polls with unresolved events

leaves.name: Burst progress meta and direct submit
leaves.replaces: NativeProgress.with_meta and the direct= argument of the transport submit
leaves.equivalence: The worker seam pops the meta key before dispatch (executor_hooks) and no worker seam runs here. Direct replies change the wire path only, which test_e3_native_reply_hol proves
leaves.cannot_prove: the direct wire path with a group in the wait

leaves.name: s5_startup._enabled
leaves.replaces: The overlap composition's settings read by _enabled
leaves.equivalence: The switch guards run after _enabled, so the real guards decide. The engine self-run starts the real startup with the settings

leaves.name: step-b-router-frontend
leaves.replaces: The API frontend, FastAPI, the Request, and the engine utility transport
leaves.equivalence: test_native41_progress_queue.RouterBase's declared leaves under the real attach_native_router, session, control client and driver
leaves.cannot_prove: the HTTP server itself: the queue's arm client and the box

leaves.name: step-b-client-utility
leaves.replaces: AsyncLLM.engine_core.call_utility_async and the session's control client, in the direct guard tests
leaves.equivalence: Records what would reach the channel; the guard under test runs before it. The Router classes run the same paths without this leaf

leaves.name: step-b-vm-dummy-weights
leaves.replaces: The real model weights and its 48 layers, with 4 layers of seeded dummy weights on one rank
leaves.equivalence: The real worker, real kernels and real attention on a real 3090. Hidden-state hashes compare device work across sizes; the size-1 repeat is the determinism control
leaves.cannot_prove: real weights, TP, PP, the engine driver, decode quality or speed on the real model

leaves.name: step-b-vm-wait-probe
leaves.replaces: The lane's queued work and scope state, with queued matmul kernels on the current stream and the exact statements under test
leaves.equivalence: The same tensor forms on the same device kind and image, with the brief's measured forms as positive and negative controls
leaves.cannot_prove: that the engine's real queue behaves as matmul kernels do: the record's host_submit_ns reads that
